name: Shoora Designs Limited
summary: Shoora Designs Ltd. is a producer of diamond jewelry, offering its collections for sale via an online store. The company primarily concentrates on jewelry made with both natural and laboratory-cultivated diamonds. Established on March 5, 2021, by founders Satish Kalubhai Kansodariya and Rajesh Labhubhai Mer, its main operations are based in Surat, India.
